name: Lenovo

evidence.quote: Lenovo Group Limited, trading as Lenovo, is a Hong Kong–based Chinese multinational corporation and technology company specializing in designing, manufacturing, and marketing consumer electronics, personal computers, software, servers, converged and hyperconverged infrastructure solutions, and related services.
